# Work Selector

Choose the next eligible unit from approved goals using priority, dependencies, and available evidence.

## Trigger

Use when approved goals have several work units and a next unit must be selected.

## Owned responsibility

Select the smallest eligible unit using priority, dependencies, capability, and evidence.

## Inputs

- approved work units
- dependency state
- priority evidence

## Outputs

- next unit
- selection rationale
- deferred units

## Stop conditions

- no eligible unit
- capability unknown
- product priority unresolved

## Validation expectations

- verify authority
- check dependency closure
- check independent roles

## Evidence policy

Compare only eligible candidates and retain bounded selection evidence.
